dedupe_keys.name: epa risk management program rmp database released under foia by the data liberation project with the rmp map viewer

description: The full US database of risk management plans filed by facilities that hold extremely hazardous substances, obtained through Freedom of Information Act requests. The Data Liberation Project page says facilities under Clean Air Act section 112(r) must submit plans at least every five years with the chemicals used, the potential effects of an accident, prevention steps, emergency response procedures and a five-year accident history; the project requested the database without the non-disclosable off-site consequence analysis and has published successive versions, the latest obtained in January 2026 with submissions through 31 December 2025. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): CC-BY-SA-4.0. Access is free of charge. The RMP Map viewer (rmpmap.org) maps the facilities and filters those with accidents using the preserved data. Coverage is the United States. Caveats: worst-case release scenarios are excluded by law, and data are self-reported. For simulation it locates toxic and flammable chemical sites with their accident histories for release, evacuation and cascading hazard models. A related catalogue record is the EPA Risk Management Plan information.
